# **Product description quality**

::: {.callout-note}

\
Each product includes a clear title, pricing, images, and a short description that explains what the product is and why customers may want to purchase it. I tried to keep the descriptions simple, informative, and easy to read. Since Harvest Haven is a farm market, I wanted the product descriptions to create a warm and welcoming shopping experience rather than simply listing product features.

\
:::

# **Assortment strategy reflection**

For my product assortment, I included ***fresh produce***, ***pantry items***, and ***gift ideas*** so customers could shop for both everyday essentials and special occasions. The customizable fruit basket adds a unique option for gifting, while products like honey, jams, and herbal tea complement the fresh fruits and create opportunities for customers to purchase related items together.

Overall, I wanted the assortment to feel simple, fresh, and connected to local farm products.

![](images/f5.png)

> ***Figure 5.** Product collections used to organize the Harvest Haven catalog into categories such as Fresh Produce, Pantry Favorites, and Gift Ideas, making it easier for customers to browse related products.*

# **CPP Farm Store application reflection**

This assignment helped me realize how important product presentation is in an online store. Clear product titles, detailed descriptions, pricing, inventory information, and high-quality images make it much easier for customers to browse products and make purchasing decisions.

To build their website efficiently, CPP Farm Store could start with a simple platform like Shopify or another user-friendly e-commerce system that allows them to quickly upload products, organize categories, and manage inventory without needing advanced technical skills. They could focus on creating a clean homepage, clear navigation menus, and a few key collections. Furthermore, they should add more variations to their products (especially gift baskets) so that customers can choose the option that best suits their needs. Using templates and consistent product formats would save time while keeping the site professional. Regularly updating seasonal products and using high-quality images would also help keep the website fresh and engaging.

Overall, a simple, organized, and easy-to-maintain website would allow CPP Farm Store to improve the customer experience while managing their online store efficiently.
